## Physical Constants

| Constant | Symbol | Value |
|:---------|:-------|:------|
| Speed of light in vacuum | $c$ | $3.0 \times 10^8 \text{ m/s}$ |
| Acceleration of free fall | $g$ | $9.8 \text{ m/s}^2$ (or $10 \text{ m/s}^2$) |
| Hubble constant | $H_0$ | $2.2 \times 10^{-18} \text{ s}^{-1}$ |
| 1 light-year | ly | $9.5 \times 10^{15} \text{ m}$ |
| Absolute zero | | $-273°\text{C}$ or $0 \text{ K}$ |

| centi- | c | $10^{-2}$ |
| milli- | m | $10^{-3}$ |
| micro- | μ | $10^{-6}$ |

## Electromagnetic Spectrum

| Region | Wavelength Range | Frequency Range |
|:-------|:-----------------|:----------------|
| Radio waves | > 0.1 m | < 3 × 10⁹ Hz |
| Microwaves | 10⁻³ – 0.1 m | 3 × 10⁹ – 3 × 10¹¹ Hz |
| Infrared | 7 × 10⁻⁷ – 10⁻³ m | 3 × 10¹¹ – 4 × 10¹⁴ Hz |
| Visible light | 4 × 10⁻⁷ – 7 × 10⁻⁷ m | 4 × 10¹⁴ – 7.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz |
| Ultraviolet | 10⁻⁸ – 4 × 10⁻⁷ m | 7.5 × 10¹⁴ – 3 × 10¹⁶ Hz |
| X-rays | 10⁻¹¹ – 10⁻⁸ m | 3 × 10¹⁶ – 3 × 10¹⁹ Hz |
| Gamma rays | < 10⁻¹¹ m | > 3 × 10¹⁹ Hz |

## Mathematical Formulae

### Geometry
- Circumference of circle: $C = 2\pi r = \pi d$
- Area of rectangle: $A = lw$
- Area of triangle: $A = \frac{1}{2}bh$
- Area of circle: $A = \pi r^2$
- Volume of rectangular block: $V = lwh$
- Volume of cylinder: $V = \pi r^2h$
- Volume of sphere: $V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$

### Trigonometry
- Pythagoras' theorem: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$
- $\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$
- $\cos \theta = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$
- $\tan \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$

### Standard Form
- Numbers written as $A \times 10^n$ where $1 \leq A < 10$
